match_stages.stage_briefing:
CM 25-09 Descent Into Madness is a 12 round, 60 point Virginia Count Classifier course. There are 4USPSA targets. The best 3 hits per target will score. The start signal is audible.

The Handgun Start Position is standing inside of Box A, wrists below belt. Handgun is loaded andholstered.
The PCC Start Position is standing inside of Box A. Carbine is loaded with stock on belt.

The Make Ready position is in Box A.

Upon the start signal, from within Box A engage targets T1-T4 with only 2 rounds each Freestyle,perform a mandatory reload, and engage targets T1-T4 with only 1 round each Weak Hand Only.
